subject: general
question: Recently, in July 2025, Brazil has honored PM Modi with its highest civilian honor, the ______________.

options.text: Grand Collar of the Merit of the Heroes of the Fatherland
Grand Collar of the National Order of the Southern Cross
Grand Collar of the Order of Rio Branco
Grand Collar of the National Order of Merit

solution:
The correct answer is __**Grand Collar of the National Order of the Southern Cross**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Grand Collar of the National Order of the Southern Cross** is Brazil's highest civilian honor.
 
• PM Narendra Modi was honored with this prestigious award in recognition of his efforts to enhance India-Brazil ties.
 
• The award symbolizes the deepening cooperation between the two countries in areas such as trade, investment, technology, and cultural exchange.
 
• This honor reflects Brazil's acknowledgement of PM Modi's global leadership and his role in fostering multilateral partnerships.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **National Order of the Southern Cross:**

 
 
• Established in 1822 by Emperor Dom Pedro I of Brazil.
 
• It is awarded exclusively to foreign nationals and dignitaries to honor their contributions to Brazil.
 
• The name "Southern Cross" refers to the constellation that is a prominent symbol of the southern hemisphere.
 
• The order has various ranks, with the Grand Collar being the highest.
 
 
 
• **India-Brazil Relations:**
 
 
• India and Brazil are part of key multilateral platforms such as BRICS, IBSA, and G20.
 
• Cooperation spans areas like agriculture, energy, space exploration, and defense.
 
• Brazil is India's largest trading partner in Latin America.
 
• Both nations emphasize shared goals in climate change mitigation and sustainable development.
 
 
 
• **Brazil's Global Partnerships:**
 
 
• Brazil is known for its active role in South-South cooperation.
 
• It prioritizes partnerships with emerging economies to address global challenges.
 
• The country is a prominent advocate for sustainable development and environmental preservation.
 
 
 
• **Brazil__: **
 
 
• The Federative Republic of Brazil is the largest country in South America.
 
• It is the world's fifth-largest country by area and the seventh-largest by population, with over 212 million people. 
 
• Capital: Brasília
 
• Official language: Portuguese
 
• President: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva
 
• Continent: South America
